environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with EFS shared volume mounted at /var/data/uploads. Container runs as root. No WAF in front of the ALB. Network load balancer passes traffic directly to the container. EFS mount uses no-root-squash and allows symlink creation by any UID. Multiple task replicas share the same EFS access point without POSIX user enforcement.

config.storage: EFS with no_root_squash, shared across tasks
